name: TechNXT AI Chat Assistant
author: technxt

sections.description:
TechNXT AI Chat Assistant helps you add an AI-powered chatbot to your WordPress website or WooCommerce store. It connects your site to the TechNXT platform so you can support visitors, guide shoppers to the right products, and launch a faster chat experience without a heavy setup process.

Whether you want a WordPress AI chatbot for customer support, a WooCommerce chatbot for product discovery, or an AI assistant that helps visitors take action, TechNXT is built to make setup straightforward.

Why choose TechNXT AI Chat Assistant:
* Built for WordPress websites and WooCommerce stores
* Helps visitors get answers, discover products, and move toward purchase
* Supports customer support, sales assistance, and lead qualification use cases
* Lightweight setup with secure connection to the TechNXT platform
* Flexible display options for the floating widget or a custom trigger button

Key features:
* AI chatbot for WordPress websites and WooCommerce stores
* Secure login to your TechNXT account directly inside WordPress
* Organization and Widget selector for choosing the right chatbot
* Optional visitor recognition for logged-in WooCommerce or WordPress users
* Visibility controls with URL exclusions and WooCommerce cart or checkout suppression
* Privacy options including optional Javascript API Key support for Secure Mode
* WooCommerce optimization so the assistant can search products and use shopping context
* Shortcode support for custom trigger buttons using [technxt_chat_trigger]

Why site owners use TechNXT:
* Improve customer support with faster answers to common questions
* Help shoppers discover relevant products through AI chat
* Create a more guided buying experience for WooCommerce visitors
* Support lead qualification and customer engagement from your website
* Keep deployment lightweight while managing assistants from the TechNXT platform

Common use cases:
* AI customer support for service and ecommerce websites
* WooCommerce product recommendation chatbot experiences
* AI sales assistant workflows for high-intent visitors
* Customer engagement on landing pages, product pages, and store pages
* Website chatbot support for agencies and SaaS businesses

This plugin is a good fit for:
* WooCommerce stores
* Ecommerce businesses
* Small business websites
* Agencies managing WordPress sites
* SaaS companies that want an AI website assistant

External services

This plugin requires the TechNXT cloud service (configured via the App URL in settings, typically https://app.technxt.co) to provide AI chat, account login, organization/widget selection, and the storefront chat widget.

What the service is used for:
* Authenticate the site administrator with their TechNXT account.
* Load organizations and chatbot widgets for selection.
* Load the TechNXT widget script and related assets (logo images, widget JS) on the admin and/or storefront.
* Power AI chat replies for website visitors through the TechNXT widget.

What data is sent and when:
* On admin login: the administrator’s email and password are sent to the TechNXT App URL (/api/auth/login) so the plugin can obtain a session.
* After login (admin only): authenticated API requests are sent to list organizations and chatbots, using the stored session cookie.
* On storefront pages where the widget is enabled: the browser loads technxt-widget.js (and the widget UI) from the TechNXT App URL. Chat messages typed by visitors are sent to TechNXT so the AI can reply.
* If “Enable visitor recognition” is turned on: the logged-in customer’s name and email may be passed to the widget for personalization. This is off by default and controlled by the site administrator.
* Admin screens may load a TechNXT-hosted logo image from the App URL.

This service is provided by TechNXT:
* Terms of Service: https://technxt.co/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://technxt.co/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the zip via the WordPress admin Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to TechNXT AI in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your TechNXT App URL and sign in with your TechNXT account email and password.
  5. Choose your Organization and Widget from the available dropdowns.
  6. Configure visibility, privacy, WooCommerce, and shortcode options as needed.
  7. Save your settings and test the chatbot on your website.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my TechNXT App URL?

It is the base URL of your TechNXT SaaS instance, e.g. https://app.technxt.co.

What credentials do I use to log in?

The same email and password you use to log in to the TechNXT dashboard.

Does the plugin track visitors?

The chat widget only appears after you connect a TechNXT account and activate a widget. Visitor recognition (passing logged-in customer name/email to the widget) is optional and disabled until you enable it under Privacy Options.

Can I use a custom trigger button instead of the floating bubble?

Yes — disable the Launcher Icon in Visibility Options and use the shortcode [technxt_chat_trigger]Chat with us[/technxt_chat_trigger] on any page or widget.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. TechNXT AI Chat Assistant is designed to support WooCommerce stores, including product search context and shopping-related chatbot experiences.

Can the chatbot help with product recommendations?

The assistant can use your TechNXT configuration and WooCommerce context to help shoppers find relevant products and move toward purchase.

Do I need a TechNXT account to use this plugin?

Yes. The plugin connects your WordPress site to the TechNXT platform, where you manage organizations and chatbot widgets.

Is the plugin suitable for non-ecommerce websites?

Yes. You can also use it for lead qualification, customer support, and general website assistance on service business or SaaS websites.
sections.changelog:
2.0.4

  • Optimized WordPress.org plugin listing copy for WordPress and WooCommerce search visibility.
  • Expanded description, FAQ, screenshot captions, and use-case messaging.
  • Updated plugin tags and short description for clearer AI chatbot positioning.
  • Added Upgrade Notice section for the latest stable release.

2.0.3

  • Improved plugin directory copy for clearer WordPress and WooCommerce positioning.
  • Expanded onboarding guidance, FAQ coverage, and screenshot captions.
  • Polished documentation for customer support, product discovery, and shortcode use cases.

2.0.2

  • Improved overall plugin onboarding and widget setup clarity.
  • Refined visibility, privacy, and WooCommerce configuration guidance.
  • Minor quality, compatibility, and maintenance improvements.

2.0.1

  • Documented TechNXT external service usage, data sent, and links to Terms and Privacy Policy.
  • Aligned text domain with the plugin slug (technxt-ai-chat-assistant).
  • Enabled SSL verification on outbound TechNXT API requests.

2.0.0

  • Replaced manual Chatbot ID entry with a full login flow (email + password).
  • Added Organization (property) and Widget dropdowns.
  • Added Visibility Options tab with URL exclusion patterns and toggle controls.
  • Added Privacy Options tab with visitor recognition and JS API Key field.
  • Added Save Changes AJAX for all tabs.
  • Removed embedded dashboard iframe.

1.0.0

  • Initial Release.
